description: Search malware hashes and retrieve Hybrid Analysis reports.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Hybrid Analysis API key sent in the api-key header. Get it at https://www.hybrid-analysis.com/profile?tab=api-key.

actions.name: get_current_key
actions.description: Get the authorization level for the current Hybrid Analysis API key.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for reading the current Hybrid Analysis API key.

anyOf.description: The numeric authorization level assigned to the API key.

authLevel.description: The numeric authorization level assigned to the API key.

anyOf.description: The human-readable authorization level assigned to the API key.

authLevelName.description: The human-readable authorization level assigned to the API key.

outputSchema.description: The current Hybrid Analysis API key information.

actions.name: get_overview
actions.description: Get the Hybrid Analysis overview for a SHA256 file hash.

sha256.description: The SHA256 file hash to look up.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for reading an analysis overview.

overview.description: The overview and scanner results returned by Hybrid Analysis.

outputSchema.description: The Hybrid Analysis overview for the requested hash.

actions.name: get_report_state
actions.description: Get the processing state of a Hybrid Analysis sandbox report.

reportId.description: A Hybrid Analysis job ID or a report identifier formatted as sha256:environmentId.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for reading a sandbox report state.

state.description: State, error, and related report details returned by Hybrid Analysis.

outputSchema.description: The current state of the requested Hybrid Analysis report.

actions.name: get_report_summary
actions.description: Get the summary of a Hybrid Analysis sandbox report.

reportId.description: A Hybrid Analysis job ID or a report identifier formatted as sha256:environmentId.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for reading a sandbox report summary.

summary.description: The sandbox report summary returned by Hybrid Analysis.

outputSchema.description: The summary of the requested Hybrid Analysis report.

actions.name: search_hash
actions.description: Find Hybrid Analysis detonation reports associated with a file hash.

hash.description: An MD5, SHA1, SHA256, or SHA512 file hash.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for searching by file hash.

sha256s.description: Canonical SHA256 hashes returned for the query.

items.description: A Hybrid Analysis detonation report match.

reports.description: Detonation reports associated with the hash.

outputSchema.description: Hybrid Analysis reports associated with the requested hash.
